title: Remove dependency on hamcrest
body: The project [depends on hamcrest](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/1de236a602d1bceae293e1e89f28d9e1f43432bd/core/test_dependencies.gradle#L9) as well as [truth](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/1de236a602d1bceae293e1e89f28d9e1f43432bd/core/test_dependencies.gradle#L7). There's only two files using hamcrest though([1](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/1de236a602d1bceae293e1e89f28d9e1f43432bd/core/src/test/java/info/nightscout/androidaps/plugins/general/maintenance/formats/EncryptedPrefsFormatTest.kt#L7), [2](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/1de236a602d1bceae293e1e89f28d9e1f43432bd/core/src/test/java/info/nightscout/androidaps/utils/CryptoUtilTest.kt#L4-L5). We can rewrite to use truth instead, and drop the hamcrest dependency.
